faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Sainik School Nagrota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Sainik School Nagrota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 TGT (Computer Science), 1 Art Master, 1 Nursing Sister (Female).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Sainik School Nagrota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (School's Website www.sainikschoolnagrota.com) and send it to the address given in the notification, to reach by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - TGT (Computer Science): 21 to 35 years; Art Master: 21 to 35 years; Nursing Sister (Female): 18 to 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay Matrix Level-7 (Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400 ) for TGT (Computer Science), Consolidated Salary: Rs. 35,000 Per month for Art Master, Consolidated Salary: Rs. 25,500 Per month for Nursing Sister (Female).

faq.answer: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Application, B.Ed, Master's degree in Fine Arts, B.Sc. (Nursing) / Nursing Diploma. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.
